h: Eniola Badmus draws attention at Zlatan's wedding as Iyabo Ojo and Ini Edo react
p: Actress Eniola Badmus reportedly stood out at Zlatan Ibile's wedding with her outfit, and fellow actresses Iyabo Ojo and Ini Edo are said to have reacted. Her moment with Davido at the event has also been noticed online.
more: Photos of her outfit are being shared on social media.
Other guests also reacted to her look.
